# cloudflare_ai_security_custom_topics (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudflare_ai_security_custom_topics" "example_ai_security_custom_topics" {
  zone_id = "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
  topics = [{
    label = "credit-cards"
    topic = "credit card numbers"
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone_id` (String) Defines the zone.

### Optional

- `topics` (Attributes List) Custom topic categories for AI Security for Apps content detection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--topics))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Defines the zone.

<a id="nestedatt--topics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `topics`

Required:

- `label` (String) Unique label identifier. Must contain only lowercase letters (a–z), digits (0–9), and hyphens.
- `topic` (String) Description of the topic category. Must contain 2–50 UTF-8 bytes. Text in any language is supported, including spaces, numbers, punctuation, and symbols. Tabs, line breaks, invalid text, and invisible formatting characters are not allowed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import cloudflare_ai_security_custom_topics.example '<zone_id>'
```
